blocks.content: Quiz: Why is query moved from Header to App in this lesson?
Tap an option below to answer:
Because header components are not allowed to hold state
Header can hold state, but in this case the query needs to be visible in App, which is higher up.
Header can hold state, but in this case the query needs to be visible in App, which is higher up.
To prevent the input from re-rendering when the user types
Moving state up doesn't prevent re-renders. It makes the value available where it's needed.
Moving state up doesn't prevent re-renders. It makes the value available where it's needed.
Because useMemo() only works at the top level of App
useMemo() works in any component. The location change is about data flow, not hook rules.
useMemo() works in any component. The location change is about data flow, not hook rules.
Because App needs to use query to filter entries
State must live in the component that uses it. App owns entries and does the filtering, and it needs to see query to do that.
State must live in the component that uses it. App owns entries and does the filtering, and it needs to see query to do that.
